title: **Pezeshkian to Putin: Iran-Russia Ties Strategic, Not Ordinary; Thanks Moscow for Support**
text:
"**Pezeshkian to Putin: Iran-Russia Ties Strategic, Not Ordinary; Thanks Moscow for Support**"

""
"Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed Russian President Vladimir Putin, stating that he appreciates Moscow's stances in support of Tehran. Pezeshkian emphasized that the relationship between Iran and Russia is strategic, not an ordinary one.
